Subject: POC kickoff — scheduling heatmap & stakeholder slots

Hi Alex —

Thanks again for the time last week. We're excited to get the POC kicked off for the Skyline ingestion workflow. To make the kickoff productive, we'd like to lock a 90-minute multi-stakeholder session to cover:

- Success criteria (data controls, latency targets, sample queries)
- Roles & owners (AE / SE / customer eng / procurement / security)
- Timeline + immediate next steps (env access, test data, pilot metrics)

Can you please:
1) Share the best 3 windows you have next week for a 90-minute slot (PST), and
2) Confirm who from Eng/Procurement/Security should join (names or emails).

I'm attaching our one-page success criteria template and a simple availability heatmap (fill-in friendly). If you prefer, I can send a shared Drive link and we can drop proposed times directly into it.

Proposed initial windows (PST):
- Tue 5/5 9:30–11:00
- Wed 5/6 11:00–12:30
- Thu 5/7 14:00–15:30

Sofia (SE) will drive the technical run-through and Marissa (CS) will coordinate acceptance criteria. Neha is looped for commercial nuances if procurement questions surface.

Thanks — looking forward to locking this in.

Best,
Logan Wright
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

+1 (415) 555-0123
